name: mumu-claude-plugin
description: Three Claude Code plugins: a team that lands reviewed pull requests, documents, and lessons that compound.

plugins.name: paperwork
plugins.description: Describe a system as one checked contract a reader can rebuild it from, and a flow of calls or work as sequence diagrams; the system skill's relay playbook applies a person's edits on a local HTML page to its file, serving the page only when asked.

plugins.name: teamwork
plugins.description: A manager routes the owner's intent to workers that define, do and close it.

plugins.name: homework
plugins.description: A lesson is filed once, where its reader looks, before the session ends.
